entry.title: 学术成果汇总
entry.content:
研究方向

分布式存储系统、LSM-Tree 键值存储、云存储、持久化内存索引

论文发表

CCF-A 类

  1. HeapKV: Enabling Efficient Garbage Collection for KV-Separated LSM Stores on Modern SSDs

    • *ACM Transactions on Architecture and Code Optimization (TACO)*，Vol. 23, Issue 2，2026
    • 学生作者，已发表
    • DOI: 10.1145/3817051

  2. RaKV: A Write-Optimized LSM Store for Cloud Block Storage with Robust SLA

    • *ACM Transactions on Architecture and Code Optimization (TACO)*，2025
    • 第一作者，已接收

  3. A Contract-Aware and Cost-effective LSM Store for Cloud Storage with Low Latency Spikes

    • *ACM Transactions on Storage (TOS)*，2024
    • 第一作者，已发表

  4. Calcspar: A Contract-Aware LSM Store for Cloud Storage with Low Latency Spikes

    • *USENIX Annual Technical Conference (USENIX ATC ‘23)*，2023
    • 第一作者，已发表

  5. Building a Fast and Efficient LSM-tree Store by Integrating Local Storage with Cloud Storage

    • *ACM Transactions on Architecture and Code Optimization (TACO)*，2022
    • 学生二作，已发表

CCF-B 类

  1. 云存储多卷负载均衡的LSM键值存储系统

    • 小型微型计算机系统，2023
    • 学生二作，已发表

  2. Building a Fast and Efficient LSM-tree Store by Integrating Local Storage with Cloud Storage

    • *IEEE International Conference on Cluster Computing (CLUSTER)*，2022
    • 学生二作，已发表

其他国际会议

  1. HBTree: an Efficient Index Structure Based on Hybrid DRAM-NVM
    • *IEEE Non-Volatile Memory Systems and Applications Symposium (NVMSA)*，2021
    • 第一作者，已发表

专利

一种 DRAM-NVM 混合索引结构的构建方法及操作方法（已授权）

研究关键词

LSM-Tree Cloud Storage Key-Value Store SLA NVM Hybrid Index Load Balancing
